Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000417" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-05-14.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000395": The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway, dependency bump)

- memory_id "1000363" [constraint]: As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, full reindex)
- memory_id "1000351" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000334": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000310" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000288": The Dune team owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Dune team, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000258": The ledger service relies on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, cache change)
- memory_id "1000175": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000171": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14, partitioning work)
- memory_id "1000147": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000089": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
